summary: No-ship: the design mistakes configured Git identity for the effective push destination, proposes a forward-only layout API that cannot preserve orphan detection, and makes the schema generator depend on its own generated artifact.

facts.relaunchTail: This is a property of the run, not of the repository, so the round's next launch may use another backend (--reviewer claude) — the caller performs that switch as its second launch; this launcher never spawns a second backend itself.

triage: review-gate SKILL.md §§ Triage and Rounds govern. Render EVERY finding as a full table row — `ID | Finding (title + full body) | Severity | file:line | Code | Recommendation | Proposed decision` — never truncated and never inside a dialog; then ask the ROUND before the rows — take every Proposed decision as it stands, or decide row by row — and `as proposed` ends the round in that ONE action; only if row-by-row was chosen, ask per finding with that row's Proposed decision as the first option, a reject or defer taking a free-text reason; echo back ONLY the rows that carried free text, and none if the round was decided by selection alone. Max 2 rounds. Append the decided rows to `docs/reviews/<slug>/decisions.md` under a `### <gate> r<n> (<reviewer>)` heading — one line per row, `<ID> <decision> — <finding title>[; <reason for reject/defer>]`, and an accepted waiver as `WAIVED by user: <reason>` — then COMMIT it with this artifact. That grammar is not decoration: the conductors anchor on `^### <gate> r<n>` and read the waiver line as the pass condition, so a ledger written in any other shape reads back as a gate still owed.

findings.title: Canonical-origin checking does not secure the actual push destination
findings.body: The predicate validates only the configured `remote.origin.url`, although its stated safety objective includes preventing misdirected pushes. Git can route pushes through `remote.origin.pushurl`, `url.*.pushInsteadOf`, or `url.*.insteadOf`. The design explicitly preserves a test harness where a canonical GitHub URL is rewritten to a local bare repository, demonstrating that this predicate can pass while the effective endpoint is different. Built as designed, init can send scaffold/marker commits to the wrong repository, and the secrets flow can push a sealed-secret commit to an unintended endpoint before detecting any later mismatch.
findings.code:
판정 강도는 secrets 쪽(앵커드: `https://github.com/` · `git@github.com:` · `ssh://git@github.com/` + `.git` 허용, 중첩 금지)으로 수렴. owner 인자화로 identity.ts의 import-0 순수성을 보존한다.

**seam 뒤로 들어가는 것**: host/scheme/중첩/.git/owner/app 판정 전부. **이동하는 콜사이트**: init.ts ensureClone(:230-234)·secrets.ts runAppSecrets(:114-117)이 술어 소비로 교체. git() 래퍼 중복(init.ts:53·secrets.ts:38)은 부수 정리.

**행동 변화(의도됨)**: init이 비표준 URL 형태(credential 포함 https, 포트 명시 ssh 등)에 fail-closed로 좁아진다 — 보안 술어로서 올바른 방향이고 기존 오류 문구("수동 확인 필요")가 이미 있다.

**테스트**: test_identity.bats류 단위 표면에 발산 축 전부를 핀(foreign-host 신규). 기존 프로세스 경계 bats는 생존 — 하네스는 insteadOf로 canonical https URL을 로컬 bare에 매핑하므로 앵커드 강화에도 무변경 통과(검증 실측).
findings.recommendation: Separate configured repository identity from push-routing safety. Before any push, reject unexpected `remote.origin.pushurl` values and canonical-URL rewrites, or execute Git with a sanitized configuration; validate the effective push URL as well as the stored origin. Add adversarial tests for foreign `pushurl`, `pushInsteadOf`, and `insteadOf`. Keep local-bare substitution behind an explicit test-only injection rather than accepting it through the production predicate.

findings.title: The forward-only layout API cannot classify the orphan artifacts the audit must detect
findings.body: `layoutFor(kind, name)` can derive expected artifacts only after kind and name are known. `audit-orphans`, however, starts from arbitrary kustomization entries, including a connection artifact whose source CR or cache directory no longer exists. If the audit enumerates known resources and calls `layoutFor`, a genuine orphan such as `db-lonely-conn.sealed.yaml` disappears from observation; if it recovers kind/name from the filename, it must recreate the parsing convention the design claims to remove. The unlabeled `envKeys` collection and singular `connHandle` also do not express the RW/RO/Admin roles needed by URL consumers without positional or suffix knowledge.
findings.code:
**심화된 module**: `tools/lib/resource-layout.ts` — 순수 문자열 유도 커널.

```
layoutFor(kind: "db" | "cache", name: string) → {
  files: [{ path, scope }],            // scope: "purge-제거" | "공유-잔존" | "수동-이연"
  kustomizationEntries: [...],
  connHandle, envKeys,
  ledgerRow?,                          // cache 전용
  tombstoneKey,
}
```

- **scope 태그가 인터페이스의 일부다**(검증 교정 반영): teardown의 purgeArtifacts는 의도된 부분집합(cluster.yaml managed.roles는 수동 커밋, 상위 kustomization databases/ 엔트리는 공유 잔존, CR ensure-flip은 drop step 소유)이므로 커널이 그 scoping 지식을 데이터로 소유한다 — 지금은 teardown 구현에만 암묵적으로 산다.
- **비흡수 경계**: yaml 편집은 흡수하지 않는다(provision-db.ts:240의 lib/kustomization.ts 직렬화 차이 이주 거부 결정 존중). 커널은 이름·경로·엔트리 문자열의 유도만 한다.

**소비 4모드**: provision-db/provision-cache(정방향 쓰기) · teardown-resource(역제거 — purgeArtifacts가 커널 집합 소비) · audit-orphans(감사 — 자체 정규식 제거, Q5) · verbs 레인 행 표면 경로 + db-url/cache-url(읽기).

**독립 앵커(Q5)**: 커널 단위 테스트에 리터럴 기대값(`db-orders-conn`·`cache-demo-conn` 등 실제 문자열)을 손으로 핀 — 정·역방향 일치 불변식을 인터페이스에서 직접 단언. 각 도구의 프로세스 경계 bats는 생존.
findings.recommendation: Make the kernel bidirectional and semantic: expose a canonical `parseArtifact`/`classifyArtifact` operation alongside forward derivation, and represent handles and env keys by roles such as `rw`, `ro`, `admin`, and `migrate`. Require round-trip tests plus an audit fixture where only an orphan connection entry remains and no source resource exists.

findings.title: The schema generator depends on the artifact it is supposed to generate
findings.body: The proposed generator imports `VERBS`, but the current catalog imports `contract.ts`, which parses `cli-result-schema.json` at module load. That creates the dependency cycle `generator → VERBS → contract.ts → generated schema`. A missing, malformed, or conflict-marked generated file therefore prevents regeneration and makes the drift gate unusable precisely when repair is needed. This is an avoidable migration and recovery hazard for a fully generated contract artifact.
findings.code:
**심화된 module**: VERBS 행에 `contract` 서브오브젝트(허용 variant 집합·action 값·chain 유무·result 정의 참조) + 생성기.

- **생성기** `tools/generate-result-schema.ts`(bun): catalog를 import해 cli-result-schema.json **전체**를 생성한다. definitions 31종의 본문은 생성기 내 데이터로 이관하되 수제 형태 유지(생성 대상의 핵심은 행렬 배선 — member 0의 21개 행렬 분기·verb/variant enum·per-verb allOf 결합).
- **드리프트 게이트**: 재생성 결과와 커밋본의 byte 동일성을 bats로 대조(make verify 경로).
- **손 앵커(열거 붕괴 방지)**: x-contract.exitCodes ↔ allOf member 1의 의도된 이중부기(스키마 379행 주석)는 한 소스 생성으로 내부 감시가 죽으므로, 대체 앵커를 bats에 손으로 둔다 — (i) variant→exitCode 리터럴 7쌍 핀, (ii) oneOf 분기 수 핀(행 수 핀 ≥1), (iii) SAMPLES 1벌(공유 헬퍼)로 수렴.

**불변(보존 계약)**: contract.ts의 x-contract 런타임 소비(모듈 로드 시 JSON 읽기·exitFor fail-closed)는 무변경 — 생성물이 표준 draft-07 + x-contract 블록을 그대로 담는다. schemaErrors(schema-check.ts)의 KNOWN 화이트리스트에 새 키워드를 도입하지 않는다(소비자는 bats뿐임을 실측 확인). 골든 검증 bats 9파일 생존.
findings.recommendation: Move generation inputs into a pure descriptor module that does not import `contract.ts` or the generated JSON. Let both `VERBS` and the generator consume that descriptor, while runtime contract readers alone consume the generated artifact. Add a test that regenerates successfully with `cli-result-schema.json` absent.

next_steps: Revise canonical-clone semantics to cover effective push routing.
Redesign the resource-layout interface with inverse classification and role-keyed artifacts.
Break the schema-generation dependency cycle before ticketing implementation.
